headline: FLOOR BOSS teaches the elbow
lede: The newest aisle law now explains itself: stack a rack that would choke a tight corner and the floor lights up the legal fix — plug a mouth and the elbow becomes an honest spur. Every taught escape is verified twice, so the lesson can never send you into another refusal.

notes.text: #2627 stage 2 shipped (76784d2): corner refusals flash green PLUG frames on the mouths that clear them, with a SPUR IT tail — and LEAVE THE ELBOW FREE when no fix is honest.
Honest-by-construction: each taught plug is checked as a legal click in its own right AND for clearing the original refusal; a pocket-trap harness rig kills the mutant that skips legality.
floorbosscheck 228/228 (+22 gates) and floorbossplay 53/53 with real taps — banners on the fx ledger, green pixel pulses probed on canvas, and the advice proven by a real plug-tap.
A concurrent lane shipped stage 1 of the same issue mid-session; the duplicate PR closed with a provenance note and stage 2 landed clean on top. Stage 3 (swing legibility) is next on the queue.
